limits: No production write, merge or deployment
Real source run OSM-only; optional Overture is regression-fixture evidence
Existing alias/code-focused index omits some named OSM features without terms
Source minZoom eligibility does not guarantee a collision-free rendered label
No cold restarted-database, remote CDN or full-region PMTiles capacity benchmark
Mobile simulator only; streamed and individual-sweep misses disclosed
Temporary QA mounts actual components; external enrichment disabled and admin rendering bypasses production outer authentication, which is covered separately by API tests
Uncategorized indexed road/building objects are excluded from ambient admission while remaining searchable
